author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
I don't think people hate Summoner T10 rushing. Sure, lower levels are fun, but higher levels are more fun?

One thing I think is important to mention for early summoners is that you *really* need to focus on survivability at T10 in ways you can entirely ignore while leveling. Raiding, towers, anguish all require more gear and overall build consideration than earlier levels, and if you haven't taken the time to get critical classes unlocked do achievements, or grind materials, you can really struggle to enjoy early T10. Everything kills you so quickly and it's challenging to do things like towers, which is necessary for progression as soon as possible. It's kind of a trap in that summoner is *so* good at raiding early on that you get XP faster than you are ready for and then the difficulty outscales what you're actually ready to handle.

author: ChaoticDemise
body:
I dislike the rush through T9. I have seen countless people want to be helped to T10 and burn out. Mostly due to being unprepared as a fresh T10 to handle much at all. Even summoner everything will be very painful without at least some peoper gear from T9. T10 from the rest of the game is very different and without some sort of knowledge and skills tends to make people quit if powerleveled from T7 to t10.

 I know you were only asking about summoner leveling. Though that has its own obstacles if not geared properly before T10. It might not be damage but survivability. 

Though you said you were playing for a year, I am unsure if you mean that as the time frame as being rushed? If so I think that's a reasonable amount of time with the games state. I coming from a perspective of a couple months.

author: petr1petr
body:
I can tell you what I dont like about it:

most people who went summoner classline since attuner and never touched anything else are lost at T10. They know nothing about game mechanics - they know just "summon buggane". They never had the need to learn about elements in weapons, in armors, about various buffs and such. Some of them will know about petrify from cockatrice, but thats about it. again, "most of them" - not all.

if you play "normal" class, you will have the need to find some answers. To learn how things work. so you get deeper in the game and you will explore what is possible and such. 

  
There is also some "hate" for summoners, because fresh T10 GS, AL0, basic equips, can kill equipped T11 player with AL100 without some big issues - summons are way too strong. for a lot of people, this is big balance issue.

The bad part is, that summoner classline is the strongest and easiest from T7 to T10 - so it is kind of hard, not to take this classline.
